meaning: Inspect repository and known facts before asking the user; ask only for business judgement.
Reproduce, investigate and identify root cause before applying a fix.
Derive expected behaviour and test strategy before implementation; use RED/GREEN/REFACTOR when appropriate.
Keep metadata always available and load full execution guidance only when relevant.
Expose repository inspection, tool execution, feedback, invariants and recovery through the harness environment.
Model long-running work using Session, Goal, Run, Round, Step and bounded Handoff.
Important actions must provide recovery, cancellation or reversal where appropriate.
Verify accessibility, responsiveness, performance, implementation integrity and design-system consistency using deterministic checks.
